doc: Explicit, versioned definitions of every game situation the Football Situational Intelligence Engine counts. A change to any threshold is a new version (situations_v2), never an edit to this file: tendencies and projections record the version they were built with. Win probability is NOT used: nflverse publishes a play-level wp but ESPN's college wp is a model refit on later seasons, so one score/clock/field-position definition is used for both sports and its agreement with nflverse wp is measured and published (research/situation_validation.json).

definitions.passing_down: down 2 and distance >= passing_down.second_min, or down 3/4 and distance >= passing_down.late_min
definitions.goal_to_go: the source's goal-to-go flag, or distance >= yards_to_goal
definitions.two_minute: seconds left in the half <= two_minute.seconds (either half)
definitions.garbage_time: |score_diff| >= garbage.by_quarter[period] (no garbage time where the threshold is null)
definitions.late_clock: period >= 4 and seconds left in the game <= late_clock.seconds; split by whether the offense leads (clock-killing) or trails (catch-up)
definitions.neutral: period <= neutral.max_period, |score_diff| <= neutral.max_abs_diff, not two_minute, not garbage_time
definitions.second_half: period 3 or 4 (overtime is counted separately and excluded from both halves)

garbage.source: score-only definition; Q4 22 is three scores, Q3 28 is four
the published cfbfastR / Connelly college garbage-time thresholds
